name: speedwrit
description: SpeedWrit: job-bound sending for AI agents. An agent may email only inside a job its owner approved; signed receipts prove every decision.

scripts.typecheck: npm run -w packages/job-send typecheck --if-present && npm run -w packages/job-send-ui typecheck --if-present && npm run -w packages/job-send-app typecheck --if-present
scripts.test: npm run -w packages/job-send test --if-present && npm run -w packages/job-send-ui test --if-present && npm run -w packages/job-send-app test --if-present
scripts.build: npm run -w packages/job-send build && npm run -w packages/job-send-app build
